verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique, attorney-led immigration law firm offering human professional services, not a software product. A built-in AI assistant to delegate tasks to is a software-product axis that does not fit this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any software or AI assistant that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
